reasoning: Small discrete spots with dark reddish-brown centers each surrounded by a distinct yellow-green halo scattered across an otherwise green leaf upper surface — classic upper-surface presentation of soybean rust (Phakopsora pachyrhizi). Frogeye has gray-tan centers with purple ring borders and less prominent halos; Bacterial Pustule shows light-colored raised bumps in denser clusters without yellow halos; Septoria shows dense angular spotting with bottom-up yellowing/defoliation rather than individual halo-bordered spots.
